rule: GOAL: Place four colored dots into slots to match the top sequence. CONTROLS: Click a bottom dot to pick it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Clicking a filled slot with a selected dot swaps them, returning the old dot to the bottom. TRAP: Assuming the bottom dot order is fixed; you must rearrange them to match the target pattern.

GOAL: Guide the falling block to the target pocket. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the paddle horizontally; Space drops the block. RULE: Position the paddle directly beneath the falling block before releasing it. TRAP: Moving the paddle after the block falls is too late to catch it.

GOAL: Clear the level by shrinking the gray area to match the target boundary. CONTROLS: Click the top blue block to move the upper wall left and the arrow right. RULE: The arrow's position dictates the boundary's location; they move in opposite directions. TRAP: Believing the arrow is just a cursor; it is a linked control that shifts the wall when moved.

GOAL: Trace the glowing path to reach the exit without hitting black voids. CONTROLS: Arrows move two spaces, hopping over a single bridge tile. RULE: You must land on white tiles, using gray bridges as stepping stones. TRAP: Assuming direct adjacency works; you cannot move one space or skip the bridge.

GOAL: Align the falling piece with the cup by setting the correct binary pattern on the keys. CONTROLS: Click key halves to toggle bits black or white; click the mouse to execute the pattern. RULE: Each black key segment moves the piece down a set distance; the goal is an exact landing. TRAP: Assuming a run persists after failure; incorrect patterns reset the piece, wasting valuable steps.

GOAL: Slide the square along a diagonal to clear all dots behind it. CONTROLS: Click a dot to move the square to that position. RULE: The square can only move a limited distance, roughly four to six steps. TRAP: Thinking you can jump far; long moves fail, so plan short, steady hops.

GOAL: Move the green cap right until it aligns with the green gate. CONTROLS: Click the blue block below the bar to shift the lower wall right and the middle wall left. RULE: Each click moves the walls four units, requiring five actions to cover the distance. TRAP: Assuming the middle wall’s leftward shift would block progress or cause a failure.

GOAL: Slide the block to the left end of the corridor to reach the handle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block two grid units in that direction. RULE: The block moves exactly two columns per press within the gray path. TRAP: Believing the block moves one unit or that complex patterns unlock the exit.

GOAL: Enter the correct code to unlock the chamber, then move the piece into the handle. CONTROLS: Keypad cells input the code; arrow keys move the unlocked piece. RULE: The code unlocks the door, teleporting the piece to the upper chamber near the handle. TRAP: Assuming the piece shrinks immediately like Level 1; it remains full-sized until moved.

GOAL: Swap tokens so each box’s slots match the strip’s order, using the arm to link their positions. CONTROLS: Click a token to pick it, click a slot to place it, and press space to check. RULE: The arm defines which slot in one box corresponds to a slot in the other. TRAP: Assuming tokens stay in their original boxes ignores the arm’s cross-linking.

GOAL: Deduce the hidden slot sequence and place matching tiles to clear the board. CONTROLS: Click a tile to select it, click a slot to swap contents, and press Space to verify the arrangement. RULE: A flash reveals a mismatch; the highlighted slot indicates the position that failed the check. TRAP: Assuming the check order is linear across all slots; it actually follows a specific, interleaved pattern that must be deduced.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding a lethal red guard that attacks along its row. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player one tile in the chosen direction. RULE: The guard lunges and kills only when the player ends directly to its left. TRAP: Assuming the guard attacks vertically; moving above or below it is actually safe.

GOAL: Fill the red box’s seven slots using the supply’s colors to match the hidden sequence. CONTROLS: Click supply items to select; click red slots to place; press space to verify. RULE: The green box’s solid marker defines the start of the sequence, dictating which red slot is first. TRAP: Assuming the hollow green item in the supply is a placeable color, rather than a marker clue.

GOAL: Rotate five wheels to match hidden target glyphs and auto-complete the level. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows move the cursor between columns. Up and down arrows rotate the selected wheel through its glyph pool. RULE: The level finishes automatically only when every visible wheel displays its correct target symbol simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming all wheels share the same glyph order wastes time. Each column has a unique pool sequence, so verify targets per column individually.

GOAL: Fill seven sequence slots to match the color strip. CONTROLS: Click supply colors to select, click slots to place, space to verify. RULE: Pre-filled squares count toward the sequence; markers block slots but define insertion points. TRAP: Assuming empty slots alone equal the strip length; you must include pre-filled squares and account for marker placement reducing fillable space.

GOAL: Move all water into the leftmost column to fill it. CONTROLS: Click a bar to push water to the neighbor on the opposite side. RULE: Water cannot flow over a bar if the destination column is already full to that bar’s height. TRAP: Thinking you must drain the middle column completely before filling the left one; instead, drain it just enough to make room for the next transfer.

GOAL: Match the long target strip by arranging a short blue sequence and two markers. CONTROLS: Click supply tiles to fill slots; click space to verify the pattern. RULE: Each marker expands to repeat the entire blue sequence at its position. TRAP: Assuming markers act individually; they duplicate the whole blue block, requiring identical adjacent repeats.

GOAL: You must push wooden crates into marked floor slots to complete the room. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character; Spacebar pushes the crate in front of you one step. RULE: You can only push crates, never pull them, so position yourself carefully before moving. TRAP: Do not push crates against walls or other crates, as they cannot be moved again and block your path.

GOAL: Fill all three containers with liquid using a movable paddle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the paddle; Space pours liquid; Mouse swaps the paddle with a block. RULE: Liquid fills a container only if the paddle or a swapped block perfectly seals it. TRAP: Believing swaps are permanent; the paddle reverts after pouring, though moved blocks stay put.

ESTABLISHED: The cable hooks the first block it touches and drags it. FAILED: Dragging green first did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply having the cable pass through all three blocks. CONTROLS: Direction keys move the plug head; the cable extends and retracts behind it.

GOAL: Navigate a grid to capture all enemies and reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; landing on an enemy removes it. RULE: You cannot step onto a square currently threatened by a live enemy. TRAP: Believing a square is safe because an enemy is nearby, rather than checking if that specific enemy is still alive and facing you.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit while avoiding a patrolling orange and a lethal red guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one tile per turn; the orange jumps two tiles forward, reversing when blocked. RULE: The orange kills only on direct contact, allowing safe movement if you never land on or swap with its current or next position. TRAP: Assuming the red guard moves; it is stationary, so its danger tile is fixed, but moving into it kills you instantly.

GOAL: Align cross arms over colored dots to collect them. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches between crosses. RULE: Arms must pass exactly through matching colored dots to clear them. TRAP: Assuming dots are obstacles; they are actually targets to be collected.

GOAL: Place the glowing bead at the exact target coordinate. CONTROLS: Clicking an empty spot moves the white marker; clicking the dark marker swaps their positions. RULE: The bead always appears at the midpoint between the white and dark markers. TRAP: Thinking clicks move the clicked object; they actually move the white marker to the click location, displacing anything there.

GOAL: Align each colored dot onto its matching plus sign to complete the puzzle. CONTROLS: Clicking the bar's start shrinks it; clicking the end expands it, moving the dot. RULE: Dots must land precisely on the center pixel of their corresponding plus marker. TRAP: Assuming dots move only when bars grow; shrinking is equally vital for precise positioning.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to align the yellow block with the fixed corner bracket. CONTROLS: Left arrow rotates counter-clockwise; right arrow rotates clockwise. RULE: The ring moves as a single unit, shifting every block’s position simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming the bracket moves with the ring; it stays fixed while the colors rotate past it.

GOAL: Position all shapes to cover every orange dot. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches focus. RULE: Shapes can overlap without blocking movement. TRAP: Assuming overlap is forbidden wasted time checking collisions.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single remaining piece by capturing others. CONTROLS: Click a piece to select it, then click its landing spot to jump and capture. RULE: Pieces jump over adjacent neighbors into empty spaces, removing the jumped piece. TRAP: Believing pieces move like chess knights or can slide freely; they must jump over an immediate neighbor.

GOAL: Align a 43-cell bar and a rotating X to clear the diamond's path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor to shift the bar; Space rotates the X shape. RULE: The bar is centered on the cursor, extending exactly 21 cells in each direction. TRAP: Assuming the bar includes the diamond's edge pixels leads to wrong length calculations.

GOAL: Move the active box into the marked ring. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the selected box three spaces. Click a box to select it. RULE: Movement is fixed at three spaces, ignoring intermediate obstacles. TRAP: Believing you must stop exactly at the ring; overshooting is possible, but recoverable by moving back.

GOAL: Move two yellow pieces into specific bracket cells by rotating overlapping tracks. CONTROLS: Click buttons to rotate horizontal and circular paths; pieces shift one step per click. RULE: Park a piece on a non-intersecting track section to keep it stationary while rotating the main circle. TRAP: Rotating the main circle with both pieces inside disturbs the first piece, forcing unnecessary repositioning steps.

GOAL: Match the target pattern by selecting the correct source grid. CONTROLS: Click source grids to project their pattern onto the display panel. RULE: Only the matching source grid updates the panel; mismatches trigger a warning flash. TRAP: Clicking the wrong source grid flashes the panel corners but wastes your move count.

GOAL: Match the overlapping mini-clue patterns to set the correct block colors. CONTROLS: Click grid blocks to toggle their color state. RULE: White mini cells mean red blocks; gray cells mean blue blocks. TRAP: Assuming the orange center icon changes the color scheme; it remains red and blue.

GOAL: Move two colored tokens to their matching brackets on opposite sides. CONTROLS: Four buttons rotated left and right cycles forward or backward. RULE: Tokens on shared cells moved with either adjacent cycle rotation. TRAP: Assuming a shared token moves only with one specific cycle wasted actions.

GOAL: Guide the green shape to the plus center using five precise moves. CONTROLS: Click the yellow panel to shift horizontally; click the green panel to extend downward. RULE: The dot must align with the center after the vertical stretch is complete. TRAP: Assuming the starting row number is the final target; it is only the cap's position, not the dot's.

GOAL: Fill the grid to match a hidden pattern using clues from overlapping colored blocks. CONTROLS: Click a cell to toggle its color between red and orange. RULE: A gray clue means the cell's color must differ from the center of the block covering it. TRAP: Assuming gray clues were optional; they strictly define the target color, so ignoring them causes mismatches.

ESTABLISHED: Two cyan blocks exist within a black crown-shaped mass. Top and bottom HUD bars shrink over time, even on no-op actions, confirming they are timers. The score remains zero. FAILED: Moving blocks to align them, placing both in the bottom row, and triggering state changes via spacebar have not cleared the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply aligning blocks, filling the bottom row, or maximizing score. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active block. Space performs a no-op that still consumes timer.

GOAL: Move the head to the final target while keeping the body clear of obstacles. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the head; click a body segment to drag it to the new head position. RULE: The head only moves to adjacent free cells, pulling the rest of the chain along its path. TRAP: Assuming you can move the head freely to any cell ignores the body's collision constraints.

ESTABLISHED: The dial rotates on a four-step cycle. The black void blocks movement. The box interior remains inaccessible even when the dial changes. FAILED: Rotating the dial to match the box icon did not open the void or trigger a win. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the dial angle to the box icon while standing on the sparkle. CONTROLS: Movement moves the block. Interacting with the sparkle rotates the dial by ninety degrees.

GOAL: Align yellow blocks to target zones by routing them through grid intersections. CONTROLS: Side handles shift horizontal lines; top handles shift vertical lines simultaneously. RULE: Blocks transfer between rows and columns only at the four central crossing points. TRAP: Assuming rows and columns move independently, wasting time on isolated line adjustments.

GOAL: Push the block onto the sparkling target to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one step in that direction. RULE: The block stops immediately when it fully covers the sparkle. TRAP: Thinking you need to adjust a dial or enter a hidden socket to win.

GOAL: Set grid colors to satisfy the mini-clue constraints for all regions. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell cycles its color between blue, red, and orange. RULE: White marks match the center color; gray marks must be any color other than the center. TRAP: Assuming gray means the base blue color caused errors; gray just forbids the center color, allowing flexible choices.

GOAL: Position colored shapes to cover matching colored dots on the board. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; click to switch active shape. RULE: A shape only counts if it fully covers dots of its own color. TRAP: Assuming partial overlap or covering dots of the wrong color counts as progress.

GOAL: Move two yellow markers to the top corners of the track. CONTROLS: Middle buttons rotate the entire track; top buttons rotate only the top segment. RULE: Track rotation shifts all markers; segment rotation moves only those on that specific arc. TRAP: Assuming uniform rotation solves the puzzle; global shifts cannot separate markers stuck on the same arc.

ESTABLISHED: The blue block moves freely on the grid. The red block retreats to its home corner when the blue is off the trail. FAILED: Assuming the red block chases the blue along the trail path. Assuming equal movement speeds allow catching the red block. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving the blue block to the trail end while the red block is present. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the blue block one cell. The red block reacts to the blue's position relative to the trail.

GOAL: Guide two mirrored blocks into the side notches near the top center of the board. CONTROLS: Arrows move both blocks simultaneously; right inputs flip the right block’s horizontal direction. RULE: The maze is mostly symmetric, but specific wall gaps break the mirror, allowing the blocks to diverge and slide into the target slots. TRAP: Assuming the maze is perfectly symmetric wastes time; you must exploit the few asymmetric walls to unlock the path.

GOAL: Place the small block into the top-left target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the active block; clicks select a new active block. RULE: Blocks slide until hitting walls, other blocks, or ring edges; active blocks ignore rings. TRAP: Assuming column alignment is flexible; horizontal moves preserve column modulo 3, forcing precise initial placement.

GOAL: Set all cells to their target colors using crosses and individual clicks. CONTROLS: Click crosses to toggle center and arms; click empty cells to toggle them individually. RULE: Crosses fix multiple arms but break the center; use individual clicks to restore broken centers. TRAP: Clicking a cross to fix its arms breaks its own center, requiring extra clicks to revert it.

GOAL: Move the dark piece onto the yellow highlight. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the piece three spaces in that direction. RULE: The dark piece must fully cover the yellow zone to win. TRAP: Assuming the yellow marks a wall or obstacle rather than the target destination.

GOAL: Lure the ghost to the pressure plate to clear the path, then reach the exit within the action limit. CONTROLS: Arrows move you; the ghost replays your previous actions to mimic your timing. RULE: The ghost repeats your recorded moves exactly, allowing you to park it on switches by timing your movements. TRAP: Assuming the ghost moves independently; it is a mirror of your past, so early positioning dictates its future location.

GOAL: Guide the dot to the yellow target by repositioning the blue block to create a path. CONTROLS: Click targets to swap block positions; use arrow keys to move the dot. RULE: The dot walks only on solid blocks, using them as bridges over empty space. TRAP: Assuming the dot can cross gaps or that swapping blocks moves the dot along with them.

GOAL: Align the piece's yellow column with the wall's gap. CONTROLS: Clicking blue blocks shifted the piece horizontally. RULE: Each click moved the piece four units toward the gap. TRAP: Believing vertical alignment was required wasted time checking rows.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to the green exit tile. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player exactly two cells in the chosen direction. RULE: You leap over obstacles; only the destination tile must be open. TRAP: Believing the intermediate cell must be empty wastes time seeking blocked paths.

GOAL: Move the charcoal block to the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the dotted object; Space switches which object is dotted. RULE: The non-dotted object mirrors the dotted one across the central wall. TRAP: Thinking the wall always moves; sometimes you must select a piece to shift it vertically.

GOAL: Move two rings to specific target slots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the base; Space grabs or drops the held ring. RULE: The cap must face the ring to grab it, and face the target to drop it. TRAP: Assuming the held ring rotates with you; it stays fixed relative to the base during movement.

GOAL: Align the bottom tab with the middle gap by moving the piece right. CONTROLS: Buttons 1 and 2 shift the top boundary; button 3 moves the piece left; button 4 moves it right. RULE: Moving the piece right pushes the middle boundary left, so you must first reset that boundary to the right using button 2. TRAP: Moving the piece right immediately fails because the middle boundary hits its limit before the tab aligns.

GOAL: Rotate the hexagonal container to align its opening with the block's edge. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the container; Space pours ink. RULE: The ink fills the container's interior only when the opening faces the target block. TRAP: Assuming the opening direction was fixed; it rotates with the container, requiring careful alignment.

GOAL: Align all columns to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; UP and DOWN cycle glyphs. RULE: Glyphs follow a fixed sequence, so shortest path between states works. TRAP: Assuming the sequence order is visible; it is hidden until you cycle.

GOAL: Rotate the plug 180 degrees and slide it right so its tips fill the green hole. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; SPACE rotates it in place. RULE: The plug’s prongs must interleave perfectly with the fixed pins to fit. TRAP: Thinking you need to move vertically; the rows already align, so only rotation and horizontal movement are required.

ESTABLISHED: Water sits above a three-plug dam. A thick rock wall separates the upper and lower chambers. FAILED: Drilling through the solid rock floor below the plug stack. GOAL IS NOT: Simply draining the top pool or breaking the bottom wall. CONTROLS: Drills remove solid blocks. Water flows into empty space.

GOAL: Move the wall to center it at row 28 so black pieces' reflections align with top yellow targets. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected item; Space cycled selection between wall and pieces. RULE: Reflections about the wall's center row must match the static yellow pieces above. TRAP: Thinking you must move the black pieces; only the wall's vertical position matters.

GOAL: Paint the bottom-right triangle orange and the bottom rows white using two ink pours. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the container between slots; clicks selected ink colors; space poured the current ink. RULE: Each slot pours a specific geometric shape, like a diagonal line or horizontal band, onto the grid. TRAP: Assuming moves follow standard screen directions failed; the path required counter-intuitive left moves to shift between bottom slots.

GOAL: Clear the corridor by removing the red hazard from its path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player two spaces and swap with any block at the destination. RULE: Moving into a block's cell pushes that block to your starting position. TRAP: Assuming the red block is an immovable wall rather than a swappable tile.

GOAL: Decode the pink word by setting each slot to the correct glyph. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the selected slot’s glyph through a fixed sequence. RULE: All slots share one global cycle order; find the shortest UP or DOWN path to the target. TRAP: Assuming each slot has a unique cycle; they all follow the same sequence, so probe once.

GOAL: Cycle through seven unique shape poses to match a target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the cursor between slots; UP cycled the current slot’s shape through its fixed sequence. RULE: Each slot had a specific shape in a predictable rotation order, allowing you to count steps to the target. TRAP: Assuming shapes were independent rather than part of a global cycle, causing unnecessary full rotations instead of minimal steps.

GOAL: Destroy three red enemies by approaching from perpendicular directions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step per press. RULE: Entering a red enemy's cell from a side it does not face destroys it instantly. TRAP: Approaching from the direction the enemy faces causes immediate death; always enter from the side or back.

GOAL: Balance five adjacent bands within strict limits using exactly twenty actions. CONTROLS: Left clicks shift values between neighboring bands, affecting two at once. RULE: You must alternate moves to keep middle bands from hitting their floors or ceilings too early. TRAP: Assuming you can solve ends first wastes turns; middle constraints force a specific interleaved order.

GOAL: Reach the blue circle at the end of the diagonal dot trail. CONTROLS: Click a dot on the diagonal to slide the purple square toward it. RULE: The path is a fixed diagonal; dots shift to fill the space left behind. TRAP: Assuming dots block movement; they shift dynamically, allowing continuous sliding.

GOAL: Fill the grid by combining ink shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the container. Click selects colors. Space pours. RULE: The cap only appears when the container is at North. TRAP: Pouring purple at Northwest covers the orange stamp if you don't return to North to click the cap last.

GOAL: Align colored plugs with matching sockets to complete circuits. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; clicks select pieces or interact with objects. RULE: Pieces occupy space; they cannot overlap or move through other objects. TRAP: Believing all moves are reversible; misplacing a blocking piece early can strand you without enough actions to fix it.

GOAL: Compose two rotation-invariant mappings to link source glyphs to final targets. CONTROLS: Arrow keys navigate slots; UP cycles through available glyph options for the current slot. RULE: Match intermediate shapes across layers ignoring rotation to chain the first and second transformations. TRAP: Assuming every cycle slot contains a valid legend item; distractors break simple label-matching logic.

GOAL: Drop the block into the gap between the cups. CONTROLS: Arrows push the block; Space restarts the level. RULE: The block slides left upon landing on a surface. TRAP: Assuming the cups were targets; they are hazards that eject the block.

GOAL: Arrange four colors in the container to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a color below to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Each color is used once, so match the top row order exactly from left to right. TRAP: Assuming clicking a slot fills it automatically; you must select the color first.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding the moving orange enemy. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character one step in that direction. RULE: Enemies move every time you move, so time your steps carefully. TRAP: Thinking you can just dash past enemies; you must dodge their future positions.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking the plug increments a counter by two. The level resets upon failure without permanent loss. FAILED: Clicking checkerboard cells, panel borders, the ball, the cable, or unlit switches causes no change. GOAL IS NOT: Activating the blue ball, flipping checkerboard tiles, or inserting the ball into the panel hole. CONTROLS: Left-click interacts with objects; the plug click adds two to a running total.

GOAL: Move crosses to align arms with dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected cross; Space switches selection. RULE: Arms collect dots only when directly overlapping them. TRAP: Assuming Space moves the cross instead of just switching control.

GOAL: Extend the green bar until its tip dot lands exactly on the target's center. CONTROLS: Clicking the bar's right edge extends it by three cells; clicking the yellow bar adjusts its vertical position. RULE: The tip is always one cell behind the bar's end, so the end must overshoot the target by one to align the tip. TRAP: Assuming the bar's end needed to touch the target caused repeated overshooting; the dot, not the edge, is the true cursor.

GOAL: Align shapes so their outlines pass through matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: Only the outline counts; internal dots are ignored. TRAP: Assuming Space cycles randomly; it strictly follows a fixed order, so plan your switch sequence carefully.

GOAL: Place the purple blob exactly inside the purple ring. CONTROLS: Clicking empty space moves the white head; clicking the blob swaps its position with the head. RULE: The final midpoint between the head and the blob must align with the ring’s center. TRAP: Thinking the white head needed to enter the ring; only the blob must land there, while the head acts as a positioning tool.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens to match a hidden target sequence. CONTROLS: Click to select, click to move; Space to submit. RULE: A pipe blocked the red row, forcing a specific read order across rows. TRAP: Assuming linear left-to-right reading ignored the pipe’s jump, causing repeated failures.

GOAL: Fill the large red row with seven colors by reading the small containers in sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette colors to fill slots, then press space to submit the solution. RULE: Read the red row left-to-right, substituting the green and blue container slots when encountered. TRAP: Assuming ringed slots are skipped; they are replaced by their corresponding small container's contents.

GOAL: Shrink the block to fit the narrow channel and reach the plug. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the block; clicking keypad cells matched the target pattern. RULE: Matching the target pattern automatically shrank the block size. TRAP: Assuming the block size was fixed prevented fitting into the thin path.

GOAL: Guide three shapes to their targets to collect matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches between shapes. RULE: Only a shape collects the dots assigned to it; passing over others does nothing. TRAP: Believing any shape can collect any dot leads to wasted moves and confusion.

GOAL: Arrange six colors and a ring into slots to match a target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a piece to select, click a slot to place, press space to submit. RULE: The ring sits in the red slot directly above the first green slot, fixing the reading order. TRAP: Assuming the ring is a static connector rather than a movable piece to be placed.

GOAL: Guide the moving piece to land on the stationary piece's diagonal to merge them into a larger square. CONTROLS: Click a target cell to move the active piece one hop at a time towards the destination. RULE: Merges only occur when the moving piece lands exactly on the stationary piece's main diagonal line. TRAP: Believing any nearby landing spot works; off-diagonal landings cause ambiguity and prevent the necessary merge.

GOAL: Build the target sequence by placing items in fixed slots and rings. CONTROLS: Click palette items to assign them to red or blue slots. Press Space to run. RULE: Rings redirect to the blue container; its content repeats at each ring's position in the output. TRAP: Assuming rings add unique values. They repeat the same blue set, so the target must contain a duplicate triplet.

GOAL: Shrink the block to pass the narrow channel and reach the target. CONTROLS: Clicks form patterns to resize the block; arrows move it. RULE: The block shrinks to its top-left quadrant upon pattern completion. TRAP: Assuming the block stays centered; it actually shifts to the upper-left corner after shrinking.

GOAL: Place rings in the top row to define container order, then fill each container with its matching pair of items. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click empty slots to place. Press space to submit the solution. RULE: The left-to-right order of rings in the red row dictates which container corresponds to each triplet in the target sequence. TRAP: Assuming containers fill based on their physical position rather than the ring order defined in the top row.

ESTABLISHED: The cord extends six cells per press and retracts fully. FAILED: Moving the right block first fails; it gets pushed to the wall instead of attaching. GOAL IS NOT: Simply extending the cord to the far right edge. CONTROLS: Down drags the bottom block; Up drags the top block; Right extends the cord; Left retracts it.

GOAL: Build a 7-item sequence with Y at position 4. CONTROLS: Place solids and rings in slots; press space to read the sequence. RULE: Rings expand into their matching container's contents at that position. TRAP: Assuming rings only link to the main row, missing nested insertion.

GOAL: Collect the marker, then enter the top room to finish. CONTROLS: Arrows move the sprite one block; the icon mirrors to show direction. RULE: The exit only opens once the single marker is collected. TRAP: Assuming the room was accessible before collecting the plus; it was sealed.

GOAL: Lift the green block to the top and slide it right to hit the target. CONTROLS: Click sky to move blocks up, yellow to shift them right, and green to extend its length. RULE: Extending green after moving right aligns the dot with the distant goal. TRAP: Extending green before moving right causes it to hit the wall instead of reaching the target.

ESTABLISHED: The initial state is mirror-symmetric. Merging blocks at the top bar does not win. Reaching extreme top corners does not win. FAILED: Pressing DOWN after merging splits the blocks but does not trigger a win. GOAL IS NOT: Simply getting both blocks to the top bar or merging them. CONTROLS: Directional inputs move blocks, but movement is coupled across the central axis, limiting independent navigation.

GOAL: Move the two blocks to swap their starting positions. CONTROLS: Arrows move both blocks simultaneously; one shifts left, the other right. RULE: The blocks are linked; they always move in opposite horizontal directions. TRAP: Trying to align them vertically or merge them wastes moves; only the exact swap works.

GOAL: Guide two shapes to matching colored pads to clear the grid. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches control between shapes. RULE: A shape only adopts a color when its center sits directly on the matching pad. TRAP: Assuming the shape’s edges or arms could touch a pad to change color wasted time.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single peg. CONTROLS: Jump over an adjacent peg into an empty spot; the jumped peg vanishes. RULE: Only straight jumps are allowed; you cannot turn corners mid-move. TRAP: Thinking all moves are safe; some jumps trap your last pegs, so check ahead before committing.

GOAL: Place the yellow block into the highlighted corner slot. CONTROLS: Click adjacent blocks to slide them along the ring, shifting positions around the loop. RULE: The ring rotates as a unit; you must cycle blocks until yellow lands on the target marker. TRAP: Assuming you can swap two blocks directly; you must rotate the whole ring to align the target.

GOAL: Move the block inside the ring to fill the center. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the block; mouse clicks confirm the position. RULE: The block overlaps the ring walls, allowing entry through solid-looking edges. TRAP: You believed the ring blocked movement, but it is only a target overlay.

GOAL: Match the 3x3 panel colors to the small reference pattern using the color mapping. CONTROLS: Click a panel square to change its color. RULE: White becomes red, and green becomes blue in the target pattern. TRAP: Clicking squares that already match the target wastes actions and disrupts progress.

GOAL: Align two yellow markers inside the brackets. CONTROLS: Click rings to rotate them; colors shift based on position. RULE: Red rings rotate clockwise, green counter-clockwise; yellow moves with its ring. TRAP: Assuming all rings spin the same way wastes clicks fighting the inverse.
